verdict.rationale: The docs touch on risk only at the edges. The CDP Facilitator runs OFAC and KYT screening to decline payments from sanctioned or high-risk addresses, and the batch-settlement scheme specifies explicit escrow with buyer refund and withdrawal semantics. Nothing in the pack documents who bears liability for fraudulent or disputed agent-initiated payments, and a community operator notes that settling after delivery puts trust on the server side. missing for 10: documented liability allocation between merchant, buyer, agent and facilitator; chargeback or dispute rules (or an explicit statement that settlements are irreversible); merchant-facing fraud-loss policy; independent corroboration.
